retrievalProfile.description: A central figure falling into a colorful cosmic vortex surrounded by disparate surreal icons and hand-drawn white doodles on a dark purple space background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central human figure in a dynamic falling pose is positioned over a swirling, multi-colored light vortex. The background is a deep purple star-field populated by floating surreal elements like a skull-rose, a heart-shaped earth, and an angel, all framed by white, hand-drawn chalk-style doodles.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure anchored by a radial light vortex
Surreal icons orbiting the central subject in a circular path
Contrast between rendered 3D elements and flat white doodles
Deep purple background providing high contrast for bright central light
coreInvariants: A falling human figure as the primary subject
White chalk-style doodles scattered in the periphery

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main figure is centrally located, scaled to occupy the middle third of the frame, appearing to fall backwards into the vortex.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow and pink vortex serves as the primary visual anchor, drawing the eye to the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: A spiral motion starting from the outer icons (angel, rose, heart) leading inward toward the falling figure and the central light.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark purple space at the corners and edges provides breathing room for the dense central composition.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow and white light from the central vortex
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant blue, green, and red from the floating icons
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the center fading to dark, low-value tones at the edges.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, blocky sans-serif with sharp, aggressive serifs
letterConstructionRules: Overlaid with thin, messy script in a contrasting color
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' features a sharp triangular peak
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy 3D block type paired with thin, vertical monoline handwriting.

avoid: Flat 2D text for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the sharp, aggressive terminals of the main title.
Matches the blocky, extruded volume of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a digital painting of a man in a grey hoodie falling into a bright yellow and pink cosmic vortex. Surround him with a skull-rose, an angel, and a heart-shaped earth on a dark purple starry background with white chalk doodles.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, 3D extruded white title at the bottom with sharp points, and a thin vertical handwritten credit on the left side.

verificationChecks: Is the main title 3D and sharp?
Is the figure falling into a central vortex?
Are there white chalk doodles in the corners?
Is the background a deep purple space?

mustAchieve: Vibrant color contrast in the center

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the 3D text has visible depth
Check that the vortex glows against the purple background
Verify the presence of the angel and skull-rose icons
Confirm the vertical text is legible but secondary
recipe.reuseFormula: Central subject + Radial vortex + Surreal orbiting icons + Chalk doodle frame + 3D sharp display type.
